title: A Sybil-Resistant Truth Discovery Framework for Mobile Crowdsensing
area: crowdsensing: truth discovery under Sybil / poisoning
multi_agent_setting: many workers (accounts) reporting to one platform; a Sybil attacker controls several accounts
problem: truth discovery fooled by one attacker with multiple accounts
method: three account-grouping methods (group similar accounts) paired with a truth discovery algorithm
metrics_result: shows existing TD vulnerable; framework 'effectively diminishes' Sybil impact (abstract gives no numbers)
limitation_gap: grouping relies on similarity of submitted data, not on physical motion; static tasks; no vehicular data
relevance_why: account grouping = linking pseudonyms to one physical sender, the core of Sybil detection on VeReMi

title: SybilEye: Observer-Assisted Privacy-Preserving Sybil Attack Detection on Mobile Crowdsensing
multi_agent_setting: users act as distributed observers of other users; data processor
problem: Sybil identities in MCS with privacy and overhead constraints
method: observer role distributed to users; Wi-Fi-connection-based detection model
metrics_result: feasibility of detection performance shown (no headline number in abstract)
limitation_gap: needs Wi-Fi co-observation; small prototype; no vehicles
relevance_why: cooperative observers = neighbouring receivers in VANET; idea maps to multi-receiver Sybil checks

title: Detecting Mobile Crowdsensing Sybil Attackers via Presence Verification
multi_agent_setting: cooperative users verify newcomers' physical presence; server orchestrates
problem: Sybil nodes joining MCS (e.g., map apps)
method: Bluetooth RSSI broadcast/listen in randomized rounds; one broadcast on behalf of many users flags Sybil
metrics_result: high detection accuracy even when Sybils are nearly the majority (abstract)
limitation_gap: requires a physical-layer protocol (RSSI) and orchestration; simulation only
relevance_why: cooperative presence verification is the crowdsensing analogue of RSSI / co-location Sybil checks in VANET

title: On the Impact of Sybil-based Attacks on Mobile Crowdsensing for Transportation
multi_agent_setting: navigation-crowdsensing users (vehicles) report congestion; Sybil identities inject fake reports
problem: how much harm Sybil congestion reports cause to routing
method: attack study: targets chosen by graph-theoretic arguments on the road network
metrics_result: Sybils at 3% of users raise average travel time by 20%
limitation_gap: attack only, no detector; reports-level not trajectory-level
relevance_why: same threat (ghost vehicles), SUMO-based, vehicular; directly motivates a Sybil detector
verified_via: WebFetch of the arXiv / USENIX page (abstract read)

title: Data Poisoning Attacks and Defenses to Crowdsourcing Systems
area: crowdsensing: truth discovery under Sybil / poisoning
multi_agent_setting: many clients submit data; malicious clients collude
problem: poisoning of truth-discovery aggregation
method: optimization-based attack maximizing aggregation error; two defenses
dataset_simulator: one synthetic + two real-world benchmark datasets
metrics_result: attacks substantially increase estimation error; defenses substantially reduce it
limitation_gap: generic crowdsourcing, no mobility / physics consistency
relevance_why: threat model of coordinated malicious agents, not vehicular

title: Disguised as Privacy: Data Poisoning Attacks Against Differentially Private Crowdsensing Systems
area: crowdsensing: truth discovery under Sybil / poisoning
multi_agent_setting: workers with DP noise; malicious workers mimic privacy noise
problem: stealthy poisoning against TD under differential privacy
method: bi-level optimization, alternating solver (DDPA)
metrics_result: maximum utility damage while undetected by TD
relevance_why: shows attackers can hide in noise — analogous to hiding in GPS noise

title: Data Poisoning Attacks and Defenses to LDP-Based Privacy-Preserving Crowdsensing
venue: IEEE Transactions on Dependable and Secure Computing
area: crowdsensing: truth discovery under Sybil / poisoning
multi_agent_setting: corrupted workers under LDP perturbation; platform
problem: poisoning hidden by LDP noise; detecting corrupted workers
method: bi-level attack (augmented Lagrangian); defense via differential evolution to remove corrupted workers
metrics_result: LDP perturbation facilitates attack; defense distinguishes disguised workers
limitation_gap: non-vehicular; detection by data residuals only
